sources.author: existing-product
sources.annotation: Current Checklist tab, stage-4 skilled worker. Four urgency buckets, no dates, 0% progress bar, titles clamp at 2 lines.
avoid: flat list with no time dimension

sources.author: existing-product
sources.annotation: Task sheet: bucket pill, full title, Why paragraph, green complete button, Learn how link. Best content on the surface.

sources.author: existing-product
sources.annotation: Add form is a full screen asking only bucket, title, description. No date field. Contradicts the layered-UI rule in CLAUDE.md.

sources.author: existing-product
sources.annotation: 147 rows; show_after_days / show_before_days / month_start / month_end all NULL. Tasks are phrased as prompts, not actions.
take: temporal columns exist as a precedent

sources.author: agent
sources.annotation: 69 users switched to Checklist; 6 completed a task; week-4 install retention 8%.
take: retention is the metric that matters

sources.author: user
sources.annotation: Product intent from May 2026: time-triggered checklist items (SIN in week 1, taxes in February), 25/50/75/100% celebrations, 'Why this?' transparency.

tensions: The bucket vocabulary (urgency) and a date (time) both express priority. Two priority systems on one card compete. The exploration must decide which one groups and which one tags.
Deadlines are user-entered facts; bank tasks are editorial prompts. Mixing them in one list risks making the vague prompts look as urgent as a permit expiry.
